What three types of goods does Aster Harbor Services transport?
Reference code AHTdev966fa3578b68458d93ef7a8b0316f1f6N1S1Q1
Aster Harbor Services transports medical supplies, laboratory reagents, and food samples.

When was Aster Harbor Services founded, and where are its headquarters?
Reference code AHTdev966fa3578b68458d93ef7a8b0316f1f6N1S1Q2
Aster Harbor Services was founded in 2019, and its headquarters are in the fictional city of Portmere.

Where are the three Aster Harbor Services transport hubs?
Reference code AHTdev966fa3578b68458d93ef7a8b0316f1f6N1S1Q3
The three transport hubs are located in Portmere, Lakeford, and Westhaven.

What are the operating hours of the hubs and the customer care team?
Reference code AHTdev966fa3578b68458d93ef7a8b0316f1f6N1S1Q4
All hubs operate 24 hours a day, seven days a week. The customer care team works Monday through Friday from 08:00 to 18:00 UTC.

What are the three service plans, and what does the Dedicated plan provide?
Reference code AHTdev966fa3578b68458d93ef7a8b0316f1f6N1S1Q5
The three service plans are Essential, Priority, and Dedicated. The Dedicated plan provides a vehicle and a route reserved for one customer.

When are Essential shipments collected, and what is the booking cutoff for same-day Priority collection?
Reference code AHTdev966fa3578b68458d93ef7a8b0316f1f6N1S1Q6
Essential shipments are collected on the next business day. Priority shipments qualify for same-day collection when booked before 10:00 UTC.

What are the maximum parcel weight and longest-side length for Priority shipments?
Reference code AHTdev966fa3578b68458d93ef7a8b0316f1f6N1S1Q7
Each Priority parcel may weigh up to 40 kilograms, and its longest side may measure up to 120 centimeters.

What temperature range is maintained for refrigerated shipments, and how often is the temperature recorded?
Reference code AHTdev966fa3578b68458d93ef7a8b0316f1f6N1S1Q8
Refrigerated shipments are maintained between 2 and 8 degrees Celsius. Temperature sensors record a reading every five minutes.

Which portal provides shipment tracking, and what are the four shipment statuses in order?
Reference code AHTdev966fa3578b68458d93ef7a8b0316f1f6N1S1Q9
Customers track shipments in the HarborTrack portal. The four shipment statuses, in order, are Booked, Collected, In Transit, and Delivered.

What does proof of delivery contain, and when does it appear in HarborTrack?
Reference code AHTdev966fa3578b68458d93ef7a8b0316f1f6N1S1Q10
Proof of delivery includes the recipient's name, signature, and delivery time. It appears in HarborTrack within 30 minutes of delivery.

What information is required for onboarding, and how long does setup take after it is received?
Reference code AHTdev966fa3578b68458d93ef7a8b0316f1f6N1S1Q11
Onboarding requires the customer's company name, billing address, and primary operations contact. Setup takes two business days after all three details are received.

Who conducts each customer's service check, and how often?
Reference code AHTdev966fa3578b68458d93ef7a8b0316f1f6N1S1Q12
Every customer has an assigned account manager who conducts a service check once a month.

How can operational incidents be reported, and how quickly must critical incidents be acknowledged?
Reference code AHTdev966fa3578b68458d93ef7a8b0316f1f6N1S1Q13
Operational incidents can be reported through HarborTrack or the 24-hour incident hotline. Critical incidents must be acknowledged within 15 minutes.

When must an unresolved critical incident be escalated, and who receives the escalation?
Reference code AHTdev966fa3578b68458d93ef7a8b0316f1f6N1S1Q14
A critical incident that remains unresolved for 30 minutes must be escalated to the Duty Operations Manager.

How often does a customer receive an updated estimated arrival time during an active delivery delay?
Reference code AHTdev966fa3578b68458d93ef7a8b0316f1f6N1S1Q15
During an active delivery delay, the customer receives an updated estimated arrival time every 20 minutes.

How far in advance must a planned route change be requested, and who approves it?
Reference code AHTdev966fa3578b68458d93ef7a8b0316f1f6N1S1Q16
A planned route change must be requested at least 48 hours before collection and approved by the Routing Coordinator.

Where is the backup dispatch center, and how quickly must it be activated after the primary center becomes unavailable?
Reference code AHTdev966fa3578b68458d93ef7a8b0316f1f6N1S1Q17
The backup dispatch center is at the Lakeford hub. It must be activated within 45 minutes after the primary dispatch center becomes unavailable.

Who calibrates the temperature sensors, and how often?
Reference code AHTdev966fa3578b68458d93ef7a8b0316f1f6N1S1Q18
Fleet Engineering calibrates the temperature sensors every 90 days.

When do drivers first complete cold-chain handling training, and how often do they repeat it?
Reference code AHTdev966fa3578b68458d93ef7a8b0316f1f6N1S1Q19
Drivers complete cold-chain handling training before their first route and repeat it every six months.

What containers and seals are used for standard packaging?
Reference code AHTdev966fa3578b68458d93ef7a8b0316f1f6N1S1Q20
Standard packaging consists of reusable insulated containers fitted with tamper-evident seals.

How long are standard shipment records and incident records retained?
Reference code AHTdev966fa3578b68458d93ef7a8b0316f1f6N1S1Q21
Standard shipment records are retained for 180 days. Incident records are retained for two years.

When is the weekly operations report published, and which three counts does it contain?
Reference code AHTdev966fa3578b68458d93ef7a8b0316f1f6N1S1Q22
The weekly operations report is published every Monday at 09:00 UTC. It contains the number of delivered shipments, the number of on-time deliveries, and the number of temperature excursions.

How often do customer service reviews take place, and which three metrics do they assess?
Reference code AHTdev966fa3578b68458d93ef7a8b0316f1f6N1S1Q23
Customer service reviews take place quarterly. They assess the on-time delivery rate, temperature excursions, and mean incident resolution time.

Who reviews suppliers, how often, and against which three criteria?
Reference code AHTdev966fa3578b68458d93ef7a8b0316f1f6N1S1Q24
The Quality team reviews suppliers every 12 months. They assess delivery reliability, temperature safety, and completeness of documentation.

In which months are business continuity drills held, who leads them, and when must findings be reviewed?
Reference code AHTdev966fa3578b68458d93ef7a8b0316f1f6N1S1Q25
Business continuity drills take place in March and September. The Head of Operations leads them, and findings must be reviewed within ten business days after each drill.
